name: veterinary_clinic_system_007_overdue_vax_owner_letters
instruction: Monthly compliance sweep, batched under the episode batch code. (1) In reminder_queue, mark every currently-queued vaccination_due row as status='sent' with sent_on set to the episode date. (2) For every patient that still has at least one overdue vaccination as of the episode date (due_date strictly before the episode date) — whether or not it had a queued reminder — push one communications row to its owner: channel='email', direction='outbound', subject='Vaccination compliance notice <batch_code>' (batch code from ops_meta), body='<PatientName> has <K> overdue vaccination(s) as of <episode date YYYY-MM-DD>.', logged_by='system', occurred_at on the episode date. (3) Push one audit-style row into reminder_queue: kind='sweep', status='done', message='sweep <batch_code>: <R> reminders sent, <C> owner notices', where R is the number of rows flipped in step 1 and C the number of rows created in step 2. Seeded communications must remain untouched.

success_criteria.summary: R = count of snapshot reminder_queue rows with kind=='vaccination_due' and status=='queued' (2). Assert those rows now status=='sent' and dp(sent_on)==ep; assert other seeded queue rows unchanged. C = distinct patients with any vaccination due<ep. Assert exactly C new communications rows with exact fields (subject carries live batch_code; body K == patient's overdue count; date == ep). Assert one new sweep row with message numbers matching R and C. Totals: communications 16+C, reminder_queue 4+1.
